released_source_gap: DGM requires mutable Git/container/task state and a host Docker daemon; released Dockerfile copies the entire repository including outcome paths

allowed_mutation_roots: ephemeral task repositories and task containers
required_isolation.audit: complete before/after digest for every allowed root plus proof that no forbidden mount, path or endpoint was reachable
forbidden_roots: host Docker daemon and persistent images/volumes
host home, SSH, cloud config, keychains and unrelated credentials
network endpoints outside the final allowlist
required_isolation.reset: destroy VM, Docker data root, networks, images, containers, mutable source and task copies after every attempt
required_isolation.source_seed: read-only filtered seed excluding initial/, initial_polyglot/ and swe_bench/ref_agent_results/; copied only inside a disposable executor
